method: Repository evidence coverage only. A selector proves that declared test source exists; it does not prove that the test ran, that an external integration passed, or that BRO is production-ready. CI results and external acceptance records must be assessed separately.

criteria.label: Canonical ownership contracts are executable
Recurring architecture lessons are executable invariants
Single-step canonical request reaches verified completion
Kernel approval resume preserves Task Step and route
Crash recovery reconstructs work without replay
Runtime readiness derives from canonical state
Multi-step dependency planning is canonical
Multi-step execution continues on one Task
Verifier-confirmed current reality can trigger governed replan
Minimal continuity and governed memory feed context
Capability discovery never grants authority
Artifact runtime records are integrated and verified
Durable scheduled wake-up reconciles into one canonical Task without granting authority
Human approval delivery and response preserve the same canonical Task binding
Runtime health, audit projection, and verified SQLite backup are executable
Acceptance runs fail closed when required external evidence is absent
Durable human approval inbox/outbox behavior is covered
criteria.limitation: No deployed notification transport or real human identity provider is exercised in CI.

criteria.label: Runtime health and verified SQLite backup behavior are covered
criteria.limitation: Backup storage remains local SQLite/file-system state; no remote retention, restore drill, or multi-node failover is exercised.

criteria.label: Production acceptance cannot self-upgrade repository evidence to external assurance
criteria.limitation: The gate validates evidence classification and required checks; actual production assurance still requires real external acceptance records.

criteria.label: In-memory governed multi-step acceptance is covered
criteria.limitation: No external business provider is exercised.

criteria.label: Verifier-confirmed replanning is covered in memory
In-process versioned adapter registry is covered
criteria.limitation: The adapter is a test lambda, not a deployed connector.

criteria.label: Registered-provider readback protocol is covered
criteria.limitation: The provider is an in-memory fake.

criteria.label: Secret-boundary mediation is covered
criteria.limitation: No production secret manager or credential rotation is exercised.

criteria.label: Release promotion state machine is covered
SQLite process-restart recovery is covered
criteria.limitation: No distributed crash, durable queue, or provider outage is exercised.

criteria.label: Canonical artifact verification lifecycle is covered
criteria.limitation: No external artifact store or tamper-resistant attestation is exercised.

criteria.label: Declared provider-health routing is covered
criteria.limitation: Health is caller-supplied test state, not an external health signal.

criteria.label: Live read-only GitHub acceptance is declared
criteria.limitation: This proves one public read-only integration when the networked test actually runs; it is not evidence of write effects or general business-system readiness.
